_INSTRUCTIONS: Return ONE JSON object with exactly these keys. For each: {value, status, source_url, notes}. status is one of verified | verify_recommended | serve_live | agreed_stable. DEFAULT TO verify_recommended. Mark verified ONLY if source_url is an OFFICIAL source you actually opened — mevzuat.gov.tr, resmigazete.gov.tr, a .gov.tr ministry or directorate (Karayollari Genel Mudurlugu, Emniyet Genel Mudurlugu, Ulastirma Bakanligi), the UN treaty database for convention status, or AAA/AATA for US IDP issuance. A car-rental company's marketing page, a comparison site, a travel blog or an insurance broker is NOT official. If you cannot source a value, return null and list the key in _open_questions. Do NOT estimate. Do NOT average two sources.
_CALIBRATION: Track record on this project: batch 16 returned 1/1 and 4/5 verified-with-official-source; batch 17 returned 3/3 and 3/3; batch 18 returned 6/6 and 7/7, both models locating the actual regulation PDF. That last one is the standard. Before these prompts were hardened, a Thailand panel marked 24 of 40 verified with only 2 officially sourced.
_WHY_THIS_LOOKS_ODD: This asks for COMPONENTS and no recommendations on purpose. The articles report mechanics; the paid guide makes the calls. Do not add advice, rankings or 'you should' framing to any notes field. In particular do NOT advise whether a traveller should obtain an IDP — the whole point is that four different thresholds (Turkish law, the rental desk, the insurer, the IDP's own legal nature) disagree, and reporting each accurately is the task.

licence.idp_legal_nature._want: What an International Driving Permit legally is — a certified translation of a domestic licence under the 1949/1968 road traffic conventions, not a standalone driving entitlement.

licence.idp_us_issuers._want: Which bodies are authorised to issue an IDP in the United States, and the fee.

licence.idp_validity._want: How long a US-issued IDP is valid, and whether it can be obtained from outside the US.

licence.idp_must_accompany._want: Whether the IDP must be carried together with the home licence to be valid.

licence.turkey_convention_status._want: Which road traffic convention(s) Turkey is party to, and what that means for recognition of foreign licences.

licence.foreign_licence_period._want: How long a visitor may drive in Turkey on a foreign licence before a Turkish licence is required.

licence.turkey_requires_idp._want: Whether Turkish law requires an IDP from a US licence holder, or merely permits one. Cite the rule, not travel advice.

licence.categories_by_engine._want: Turkish licence categories for motorcycles, scooters and mopeds by engine size, and what each permits.

licence.car_licence_covers_scooter._want: Whether a car licence (Turkish class B, or a US equivalent) permits riding a scooter or moped in Turkey, and up to what engine size.

licence.atv_quad_status._want: How ATVs and quads are classified in Turkish law, and what licence they require on public roads.

rental.minimum_age._want: Minimum driver age for car rental in Turkey and any young-driver surcharge threshold.

rental.licence_held_duration._want: How long a driver must have held their licence to rent a car in Turkey.

rental.credit_card_requirement._want: Whether a credit card in the driver's name is required, and the typical deposit or pre-authorisation held.

rental.documents_inspected._want: Which documents a Turkish rental desk inspects at the counter.

rental.cross_border_restrictions._want: Restrictions on taking a Turkish rental car across a border, and one-way rules.

insurance.compulsory_third_party._want: Turkey's compulsory motor third-party liability insurance — what it covers and what it does not.

insurance.cdw_and_excess._want: How collision damage waiver and the excess work on Turkish rentals, and what a super-CDW buys down.

insurance.standard_exclusions._want: The standard exclusion list on Turkish rental insurance: tyres, glass, undercarriage, mirrors, interior, and any others.

insurance.deposit_vs_excess._want: How the held deposit relates to the excess in practice.

driving.speed_limits._want: Turkish speed limits by road type for a passenger car.

driving.alcohol_limit._want: The blood alcohol limit for drivers in Turkey, including any lower limit for drivers towing or professional drivers.

driving.seatbelt_phone_childseat._want: Seatbelt, mobile phone and child restraint rules.

driving.helmet_law._want: Helmet law for motorcycle and scooter riders and passengers.

tolls.hgs_system._want: The HGS electronic toll system — how it works, and how rental cars are normally equipped.

tolls.unpaid_penalty._want: What happens when a toll goes unpaid: the grace period, the surcharge, and how it is collected from a rental customer.

fines.how_they_reach_renter._want: How a traffic or parking fine incurred in a rental car reaches a foreign renter, and what administrative fee rental companies typically add.

accident.legal_requirements._want: What Turkish law requires at the scene of a road accident — reporting, moving vehicles, the accident report form.
